description: The exposure_class values of an exposure signature: the family of AI component that a matched response shape proves publicly reachable. attackVector is the documented join to the Agent Threat Matrix attackClasses id a signature of that class carries in attack_vector; null means the signature carries no attack_vector. A reserved class is a valid value with no signature yet.

classes.description: An MCP server answering JSON-RPC requests such as tools/list or resources/list.
An LLM gateway or proxy that fronts several model backends behind one API (LiteLLM and similar).
A self-hosted inference server or its UI (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, LocalAI).
An agent framework serving runnables or chains over HTTP (LangServe, AutoGen, CrewAI).
A vector database management or query endpoint (Chroma, Qdrant, Milvus, Weaviate).
A retrieval augmented generation service exposing query or ingestion endpoints (Haystack, RAGFlow).
A self-hosted copilot style proxy exposing completion endpoints.
A tool registry or MCP catalogue listing installable tools or servers.
